title: HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes
summary: Bitcoin Magazine HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes HRF's Bitcoin Development Fund backed seven projects for self-custody, privacy and education under repression, from phone wallets to solar mining in Nigeria. This post HRF Announces Funding of Seven Bitcoin Projects for People Living Under Authoritarian Regimes first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
